_how_to_edit: Finished setups for /setups/ideas/ and the home page. s is a Desk Setup Builder state (see data/setup_builder.json for keys and option ids). After editing run: node tools/render_setups.js && python3 tools/setups_page.py

setups.name: All-white minimal
setups.blurb: White desk, white PC, white gear and a warm strip of light underneath. Calm, bright and easy to keep tidy.

setups.name: Neon cyberpunk
setups.blurb: Cyan hex panels, an ultrawide and RGB on every surface. Turn the room lights off and let the desk glow.

setups.name: Cozy wood cabin
setups.blurb: Warm wood, a corner lamp, a cream keyboard and a plant. A desk that feels like a weekend at the lake.

setups.name: First setup on a budget
setups.blurb: Budget picks for every piece, with an Xbox Series S doing the gaming. A real starter desk without the big bill.

setups.name: Small apartment corner
setups.blurb: A compact standing desk, a laptop and a lavender floor lamp. Fits in a corner and folds into work hours.

setups.name: Dual-screen streamer
setups.blurb: Two screens, a boom mic, a webcam and a stream deck. Game on one screen and run chat and alerts on the other.

setups.name: Console TV corner
setups.blurb: A big TV on a wood console, a PlayStation and speakers either side. Grab the controller and sink in.

setups.name: Handheld cozy corner
setups.blurb: A handheld PC in its dock doubles as the desk computer. Play at the desk, then take it to the couch.

setups.name: Black stealth
setups.blurb: No lights, no color, just black gear on a black desk. Quiet, serious and built for focus.

setups.name: Pastel dream
setups.blurb: Lavender light bars, a white desk and soft white gear. Gentle colors that still look great on camera.

setups.name: Bubblegum pink
setups.blurb: Pink hex panels over an all-white build with a curved screen. Bold color on a budget.

setups.name: Retro arcade
setups.blurb: Orange glow, a cream keyboard and a city map desk mat. Feels like an arcade after closing time.

setups.name: Sim racing rig
setups.blurb: A racing wheel clamped to the desk in front of an ultrawide, with red light bars. Built for laps, not spreadsheets.

setups.name: Veteran ops room
setups.blurb: Olive light, a wooden flag on the wall and solid black gear. Made for late squad nights with the people you served with.

setups.name: Squad night streamer
setups.blurb: Two screens, a mic and a webcam for streaming squad games, with the flag behind you on camera.

setups.name: GTA 6 night drive
setups.blurb: A PS5 Pro, a big TV and pink neon, ready for launch night in Leonida. No keyboard needed.

setups.name: College dorm desk
setups.blurb: A laptop, a compact keyboard and a light bar on a small white desk. Study by day, game by night.

setups.name: Lofi study night
setups.blurb: A purple lamp, a cream keyboard and a laptop on warm wood. Put on a lofi playlist and get to work.

setups.name: Ultrawide immersion
setups.blurb: A 34-inch ultrawide on a standing desk with speakers and a light bar. Wide games, wide spreadsheets.

setups.name: Esports pro
setups.blurb: A fast 27-inch screen, a light wireless mouse and a compact keyboard. Everything tuned for aim, nothing extra.

setups.name: Creator studio
setups.blurb: Two white screens, a mic, a webcam and a stream deck, lit warm and soft. A desk for editing and recording.

setups.name: Forest green
setups.blurb: Green glow, wood, a plant and a cream keyboard. Brings a bit of the outdoors inside.

setups.name: Ocean blue
setups.blurb: Blue light bars over a white build with a curved screen. Clean like the minimal look, with more color.

setups.name: Desert sunset
setups.blurb: Orange hex panels, a wood desk and an ultrawide. Warm colors that match a sunset wallpaper.

setups.name: Crimson battlestation
setups.blurb: Red hex panels, two screens and RGB gear on black. Loud, proud and ready for raid night.

setups.name: Work and play standing desk
setups.blurb: A standing desk with two screens, a laptop and a webcam. Calls all day, games after five.

setups.name: Xbox night on a budget
setups.blurb: An Xbox Series S on a big TV with green light behind it. A living room setup at a starter price.

setups.name: SteelGames purple
setups.blurb: Our own colors: purple hex panels, a curved screen and a white controller on black. The setup we would build.
